# small c cut

> “Small c” is the term I use for quiet, strategic reductions that unlock real change over time.
> Ali Al Mokdad

smallccut.org is a single page. It holds nine field photographs taken by Ali Al Mokdad
in the course of humanitarian and development operations work, and the nine pieces each
photograph belongs to. Every photograph is a small observed thing that shows what the
system is actually doing: a lorry whose load towers above its cab, a taxi carrying an air
conditioning unit on its roof, a wall papered with hand drawn Like buttons.

A small c cut is distinguished from what he calls a Capital C Cut, meaning a loud sweeping
restructure. His own phrasing for the method: "One precise correction at a time. No
restructure required. No new committee."

## The nine pieces

01. [Reducing INGO Overhead with Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ali-al-mokdad_smallccut-ingotransformation-operationalexcellence-activity-7401927984095330304-5_kT/)
    topic: overhead
    line: An office that no longer opens doors is not representation, it is overhead.

02. [Unlock Efficiency at INGO HQ with a ‘Small c’ Cut](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/unlock-efficiency-ingo-hq-small-c-cut-ali-al-mokdad-ogmsf/)
    topic: headquarters
    line: If the internal report isn’t prompting a decision, it’s just decoration.

03. [Dear INGO HQ: Fix Your Strategy with a ‘Small c’ Cut](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/dear-ingo-hq-fix-your-strategy-small-c-cut-ali-al-mokdad-nhyxf/)
    topic: strategy
    line: What we lack isn’t strategy. It’s strategic memory, strategic courage, and a design rooted in reality.

04. [Optimizing INGO Transformation with the Small c Cut](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/optimizing-ingo-transformation-small-c-cut-ali-al-mokdad-6maqf/)
    topic: transformation
    line: Cut what drains. Cut what distracts. Cut what slows.

05. [Unlocking Regional Office Value with Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/unlocking-regional-office-value-small-c-cuts-ali-al-mokdad-jqscf/)
    topic: regional offices
    line: If organizations cannot share a fleet, they are not ready to share a strategy.

06. [Smarter NGO Fundraising With Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/smarter-ngo-fundraising-small-c-cuts-ali-al-mokdad-xjfvf/)
    topic: fundraising
    line: Fundraising is not revolution. It is optimisation in small shapes.

07. [Turning NGO Advocacy Into Influence With Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/turning-ngo-advocacy-influence-small-c-cuts-ali-al-mokdad-j3swe/)
    topic: advocacy
    line: Influence is not a vibe. It is a practice.

08. [Dear NGO: Your Risk Management Is the Risk — Fix It with Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/dear-ngo-your-risk-management-fix-small-c-cuts-ali-al-mokdad-peaje/)
    topic: risk
    line: A traffic light that never stops traffic is just decoration.

09. [Rethinking NGO Digital Transformation with Small c Cuts](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/rethinking-ngo-digital-transformation-small-c-cuts-ali-al-mokdad-hrsse/)
    topic: digital
    line: The tool was real. The transformation was not.
